profile.name: Azizbek Juraev
profile.headline: International Business & Trade
profile.tagline: Business student with a marketing and operations foundation, three countries of hands-on work experience, and four working languages.
profile.objective: High-achieving International Business & Trade student at Inha University (4.39/4.5 GPA) and full-ride Global Scholarship recipient with international operations experience across South Korea, Germany, and Brunei. Proven ability in cross-cultural team coordination, inventory management, and client relations, supported by fluency in English and native Uzbek alongside intermediate Korean proficiency. Adept at leveraging data analysis and process optimization to streamline workflows and drive organizational efficiency.

bullets: Used AI-powered voice picking systems to locate, assemble and fulfil daily warehouse orders.
Adapted to a dynamic international work environment and collaborated effectively during a 3-month cultural exchange program.
Taught English to children aged 10–15 through interactive lessons and activities.
Assisted in camp management and daily program coordination.
Assisted guests with check-in and check-out and provided local information in English and Korean.
Handled reservations, phone calls and guest requests to ensure a smooth customer experience.
